explanation: Special case N = 25 of erdosproblems.com/686: ∃ k ≥ 2, n, m ≥ n + k with 25 = ∏(m+i)/∏(n+i), tagged as an open question. The forum thread lists 25 among the squares with no known representation (excluded for k ≤ 4 and conjecturally unrepresentable, as with other squares of primes p ≥ 5), so the open status is consistent. Correctly stated instance of the main problem.
